title: Configured test scripts do not run included integration tests
reasoning: The default test script excludes all *.integration.test.ts files, while test:integration only targets app/queries/__tests__/*.integration.test.ts. The included auth integration test is app/__tests__/integration/auth.test.tsx, so it is not selected by either script: it uses .tsx and lives outside app/queries/__tests__. As a result, authentication-flow coverage can silently rot even though it is listed as an associated test for this feature.
reproduction: Run npm run test:integration; the configured glob only covers app/queries/__tests__/*.integration.test.ts and will not include app/__tests__/integration/auth.test.tsx.
recommendation: Broaden test:integration to include integration tests under app/__tests__/integration and both .ts and .tsx extensions, or move/rename the auth integration test to match the existing integration glob.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: This is a script selection issue: the test exists, but the package scripts shown do not include it in either the normal or integration test command.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a CI or package-script smoke check that runs vitest with the integration glob and includes app/__tests__/integration/auth.test.tsx.
minimumFixScope: Update package.json test:integration glob or relocate the integration test to match the configured glob.
